service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME FROM USERVICE WHERE HOUSE_CODE <> '000' AND HOUSE_CODE = $S{HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ( UPPER( HOUSE_CODE ) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ), '%') OR UPPER( COMPANY_NAME ) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ), '%'))
SELECT CODE , DESCRIPTION FROM UPUSH WHERE DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND ( 1=1 AND CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') OR DESCRIPTION LIKE CONCAT('%', $S{F_KEYWORD}, '%') )
SELECT CODE , `TYPE` , OPTION_NAME , OPTION_VALUE FROM UPUSO WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND CODE = ${CODE} AND `TYPE` IN ($IN{TYPE})
SELECT CODE , `TYPE` , OPTION_NAME , OPTION_VALUE FROM UPUSO WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND CODE = ${CODE} AND `TYPE` IN ($IN{TYPE})
